subject.title: Gateway crash-loops with default Node heap (~4 GB) — make 'openclaw daemon install' set NODE_OPTIONS or accept a --heap-mb flag

question: Should OpenClaw solve this Gateway OOM crash-loop by adding a fixed managed-service Node heap cap, a configurable CLI/config surface, or a diagnostic-only warning?
rationale: The current bug is valid, but the fix changes managed service startup defaults or adds a new configuration surface, and NODE_OPTIONS is currently a blocked security-sensitive environment key.

options.title: Land a narrow default cap
options.body: Use a fixed Node heap cap for managed Node gateway services and cover fresh install plus forced reinstall without exposing NODE_OPTIONS as user-managed service env.

options.title: Add an explicit tuning surface
options.body: Add a --heap-mb or durable config setting with docs and upgrade tests, accepting the extra CLI/config compatibility surface.

options.title: Warn only for now
options.body: Leave startup defaults unchanged and add gateway status or doctor detection that tells operators how to configure a wrapper/manual service override.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow default cap
recommendation.body: Use a fixed Node heap cap for managed Node gateway services and cover fresh install plus forced reinstall without exposing NODE_OPTIONS as user-managed service env.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main daemon install code path blames to this recent area contributor in the checked-out history, though original ownership is not fully visible.
